description: Cemu controllerProfiles/<profile>.xml is GENERATED from the profile (DirectInput API, the wheel's instance GUID). <mapping> = emulated-controller slot, <button> = Cemu DirectInput input code. Wii U Pro Controller slots: 1 A, 2 B, 3 X, 4 Y, 5 L, 6 R, 7 ZL, 8 ZR, 9 Plus, 10 Minus, 11 Home, 12 Up, 13 Down, 14 Left, 15 Right, 16 L-stick click, 17 R-stick click, 18-21 L-stick Up/Down/Left/Right, 22-25 R-stick Up/Down/Left/Right. Cemu DirectInput codes: 0-31 buttons, 34-37 hat Up/Down/Left/Right, axis halves X+ 38, Y+ 39, Rx+ 40, Ry+ 41, Z+ 42, Rz+ 43, X- 44, Y- 45, Rx- 46, Ry- 47, Z- 48, Rz- 49 (sliders are not readable through Cemu's DirectInput API). Layout entries name a profile control; 'Steering-' / 'Steering+' = the half of the axis; pedals use the half they travel to when pressed.

000500001010ec00.title: Mario Kart 8 (USA)
000500001010ec00.notes: A = gas pedal, R (hop / drift) = brake pedal, B (brake / reverse) = a wheel button; paddles = L / ZR. gameProfiles ini selects controller1 = <profile name>.

keyboardPanels_description: Stand-up / pedestal cabinets: the joysticks and buttons are keyboard encoders (I-PAC style), so Cemu gets Keyboard-API profiles. Keys are Windows virtual-key codes (what Cemu's keyboard controller records). Defaults follow the I-PAC / MAME layout; override a key here if the panel is wired differently. GamePad slots: 1 A, 2 B, 3 X, 4 Y, 5 L, 6 R, 7 ZL, 8 ZR, 9 Plus, 10 Minus, 11-14 D-pad Up/Down/Left/Right, 17-20 L-stick Up/Down/Left/Right. Pro Controller slots as above (12-15 D-pad, 18-21 L-stick).
